items.title: Consumer self-upgrade preflight requires an unavailable source-only capability adapter
items.body:
## Observed
The development consumer install is running release d104cd37c99ef85c8f8df5acfcd267bf1ff446a7. After the verified v2026.08.24-consumer-self-upgrade.3 release became available at source 65be1fd7215a88ac7d2c9c9c1bae0dac4b0a5eff, the normal authenticated /ops/self-upgrade action created SUR-F8885052.

The run resolved the exact target and failed closed during promoter readiness before quiescence or swap:

`promoter-readiness-failed: Promoter readiness check failed: capability_projection_failed: candidate source has no profile adapter at /host-source/scripts/lib/resolve-capability-compose-profiles.mjs`

The install is intentionally release-artifact/consumer mode and has no source checkout or /host-source adapter. The running portal remained healthy on d104cd3. This blocks deployment of PR #4633 / merge ddd1ae31e2d63b44cffd18a13d095948ce2fb6bf and therefore blocks live initiative-readiness.v2 verification.

## Acceptance
1. A consumer release-artifact install can preflight and apply a verified release without a host source checkout.
2. Capability projection for release-artifact targets resolves from the immutable release/promoter contract or another release-owned artifact; it never requires `/host-source`.
3. Source-backed installs retain their existing source adapter path and fail-closed checks.
4. A bootstrap regression starts from the d104cd3-era runner, targets the 65be1fd corrective release, and reaches quiescence/swap/health success through the normal self-upgrade pipeline.
5. Failure continues to leave the current portal serving and records exact durable evidence; no hand Compose/image/database deployment workaround is introduced.
items.scopeRationale: Platform deployment substrate defect specific to consumer release-artifact self-upgrade preflight; it affects every consumer installation and no business archetype behavior.
items.resolution: A fail-closed platform deployment bug blocks all consumer installs from traversing the governed upgrade path. The fix needs release/source mode separation plus a bootstrap functional regression, so it is bounded but not a one-line repair.

items.title: Self-upgrade rejects Docker Desktop index-stratum image identity
items.body:
Observed run: SUR-C2456AD8 (failed safely before quiescence/mutation).

Corrected diagnosis: the official release identity correctly carried the linux/amd64 config digest sha256:694d05a57131ca608ae767bfab18a4b2d2d051a308a123aa43966079b3868df0. On Windows Docker Desktop/containerd, docker image inspect .Id for the pulled multiarch tag exposed the channel/index digest sha256:bfaeee345dee819575e14308d0583c5ce5cf3977806dac2aba99e4b0cf927b7a. The promoter incorrectly assumed .Id was always the OCI config digest.

Acceptance: carry the registry-frozen channel/index, selected platform-manifest, config digest, OS, and architecture through target/preflight/promotion; accept an engine .Id only when it matches one of those immutable frozen digest strata; retain exact tag, source revision, version, OS, architecture, and fail-closed pre-mutation checks. Cover classic config-ID and Docker Desktop index-ID behavior, plus unknown digest and wrong-platform rejection. Preserve SUR-C2456AD8 as evidence and do not retry release .7.
items.scopeRationale: Cross-engine self-upgrade release identity validation in the platform promoter; subject-agnostic and not archetype-specific.
items.resolution: A reproducible cross-engine promotion defect blocks the canonical consumer upgrade before mutation. The bounded repair and functional acceptance matrix are already isolated in WC-6A9A0D9D.

items.title: Make immutable source review traversable under bounded local-model context
items.body: Repeated governed independent reviews call read_source_at_version successfully but cannot evaluate long immutable artifacts. Exact 2026-08-25 evidence on BI-FFBDDD96 / WC-DAF911CD: TaskRun TR-MCP-Y210Nmg3bjg3MDBnYTAxbXhheDU2MXV2aQ-DEBC22C60AD7 persisted two successful immutable reads (cmt9ajtna000f4pnzkljsmlgt, cmt9ak16t000m4pnzws4uj5s6), yet the Qwen3.8 27B reviewer received only the file opening and proposed a fail without reaching the acceptance criteria. Source trace: read_source_at_version duplicates the full file in message and data.content; agentic-loop clamps it to a window share, then compactAgenticMessages reduces the retained result to 1,500 head characters on a 32K model. The tool has no offset/range/section parameter, so retries return the same prefix. Recurrence signal IS-61BB62FF was already 3 before this new occurrence. Acceptance: add deterministic immutable range/section traversal (or equivalent server-derived complete-artifact projection), eliminate duplicate model-facing serialization, preserve exact commit/path/blob binding and global context limits, prove long-artifact reviewers can reach all required sections and persist a valid governed receipt, and remain fail-closed on incomplete traversal.
items.scopeRationale: Shared TAK agent-loop context compaction and immutable source reader contract affect every governed independent review route.
items.resolution: Auto-triaged by scheduled drain: A specific recurring failure in a named tool with repeated blocking impact is concrete, actionable engineering work that can be investigated and stabilized.
